description: Page listPostgresServiceBackups by cursor. The operation takes `cursor` and `limit` query parameters and answers { status, requestId, result: [...], limit, nextCursor } (the spec describes nextCursor as 'Cursor for the next page, to be sent as the `cursor` query parameter. Null on the last page.'). The converter's cursor detection does not recognise `nextCursor`, so the list was a single-page call. Not called live: no Postgres service existed to list backups for. The multi-page traversal was captured on listApiKeys, which answers the same envelope per the spec.
